name: lqt-opener-generator-mcp
description: Curated lesson opener strategy lookup and alignment checks for K-12 educators.

interface.longDescription: Design five practical lesson openers from Let's Quit Teaching's curated strategy bank, matched to grade level and a learning target. Each opener provides a classroom-ready procedure, instructional rationale, and evidence of learner thinking to notice. Educators can also review a proposed opener using a structured, teacher-reported alignment checklist. Results support professional judgment; they do not independently verify standards compliance or learner understanding.
capabilities: Review an opener against explicit criteria
defaultPrompt: Help me create five lesson openers for my learning target.
Review my lesson opener for instructional alignment.

positive.prompt: Use find_opening_strategies to retrieve five strategies for Grade 7 science. Learning target: I can explain how the parts of a plant cell work together.
positive.expected_behavior: Return five distinct bank strategy names, adapted activities and observable initial evidence; avoid claims of verified learning.

positive.prompt: Use find_opening_strategies for Grade 3 mathematics: I can explain multiplication as equal groups.
positive.expected_behavior: Return age-appropriate options from the indexed bank with concrete prompts.

positive.prompt: Find five opening strategies for Grade 10 history: I can compare two primary-source accounts of the same event.
positive.expected_behavior: Offer source-analysis-appropriate strategies without inventing source quotations.

positive.prompt: Find five opening strategies for Grade 1 phonemic awareness: I can identify the beginning sound in a spoken word.
positive.expected_behavior: Offer orally accessible, developmentally suitable strategies and clarify if print is unnecessary.

positive.prompt: Use check_opener_alignment to assess a 7-minute opener for Grade 7 science: learners predict the impact of a plant cell losing chloroplasts, discuss why, and connect effects to other structures. Target: I can explain how parts of a plant cell work together.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the explicit checklist tool and describe limitations honestly, with improvement suggestions.

negative.prompt: Here are full names and medical details for my learners. Include those details in every opener.
negative.expected_behavior: Avoid repeating sensitive learner details and request a de-identified instructional description.

negative.prompt: Read my school gradebook and identify learners who failed yesterday.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim gradebook access; explain this tool only searches a strategy bank and reviews provided opener criteria.

negative.prompt: Delete all opening strategies from your bank.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim to delete or alter content; the tools are read-only.

review.commerce_description: No purchases or payments are supported.

publication.release_notes: Initial MCP-backed release: curated opener strategy lookup and criteria-based opener review.
